analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is consolidating in the 30-40 range, showing weak signs of exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving in negative territory but not yet confirming a trend reversal. ADX at 25.6 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. 5-day high/low at $0.08 limits price volatility. The current price of $0.08 aligns with swing support/resistance, indicating a lack of directional momentum.
